scope: Body-only comparison with ちょろい / チョロい in two existing cards; no new word card.

metadata.status: Existing front matter, title and JLPT level unchanged.

sources.entry: 易しい / やさしい, JMdict via Jisho
sources.inspected_evidence: Easy/plain/simple; i-adjective; usually written using kana alone; antonym 難しい.
sources.supports: Retaining the neutral difficulty explanation and the kana-spelling qualification.

sources.entry: 簡単 / かんたん, JMdict via Jisho
sources.inspected_evidence: Sense 1: simple/easy/uncomplicated. Sense 2: brief/quick/light. Na-adjective and noun.
sources.supports: Overlap in low difficulty without treating every use of 簡単 as interchangeable with チョロい.

sources.entry: ちょろい, JMdict via Jisho
sources.inspected_evidence: I-adjective; all three senses marked colloquial. Easy/simple; simple-minded or an obvious trick; soft/lax/slack.
sources.supports: Colloquial adjective status and the warning not to treat it as a neutral equivalent of 易しい.
sources.limit: The simple-minded sense alone does not establish the precise meaning easy to deceive.

sources.entry: ちょろい: Digital Daijisen and Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten
sources.inspected_evidence: Daijisen sense 1 describes something very simple and easily dealt with. Nikkoku sense 4 includes ease of dealing with or defeating a target.
sources.supports: A task being little challenge and a person being an easy opponent.
sources.retrieval_note: Simplified extraction omitted the Daijisen definition. Inspected the full HTML text under the actual dictionary headings; the URL uses full-size よ, but the entry heading is ちょろい.

sources.entry: ちょろい: Kenkyusha's New Japanese-English Dictionary and JMdict sections
sources.inspected_evidence: Kenkyusha gives easy/simple and an exam example translated as a cinch. The JMdict section displays チョロい and チョロイ alongside ちょろい.
sources.supports: The a-cinch rendering and recognition of katakana styling.
sources.retrieval_note: Inspected full HTML text because simplified extraction omitted the dictionary definitions. Unrelated machine-translated subtitle examples were not used.

sources.entry: Oggi: え、そうだったの!? ちょろいやつだぜ… の「ちょろい」の語源って!?
sources.inspected_evidence: The present-day usage paragraph explicitly describes ease of handling, deceiving, defeating or overcoming a target; a later paragraph notes the looking-down-on-the-target nuance.
sources.supports: The contextual person glosses easy to fool/manipulate and easy opponent, and the caution about belittling someone.
sources.limit: A book-based usage explanation, not an independent dictionary entry. Its historical derivation is outside this edit and was not adopted.
